gap: Every paper and sticker casts a hard, near-black drop shadow (a ~5 px core at about 40% of the wall's brightness along the right and bottom edges, and star/heart shadows offset ~20 px so the stickers look like they hover off the wall) instead of the bar's soft, barely-there contact shadows.
notes: Name, riso 'Liew', note, chips, plaster and window light match the bar almost exactly; 5 papers + 2 stickers, all right of centre; the cue 'SCROLL TO TAKE A PHOTO' says what happens next; no console errors or failed chapters. Secondary: (1) the four photo corners marking the strip spot are flat near-black triangles with no sheen or shadow, darker than anything else on the wall; at 480 px they read as stray specks and the spot between them is plain wall, so it is visible but not yet inviting. (2) The SPEX photo's right-edge shadow is unevenly stair-stepped. (3) 'the photo lands here!' is in brown ink (#62321b) next to the ballpoint-blue main note. (4) Chrome: 'KUCHING, SARAWAK' sits in the mullion shadow and 'SCRAPBOOK N° 12' is almost invisible in the top-right shade (same as the bar); the scroll cue is only about 3.3:1 against the wall.
